note: Files that change only with the owner's signed approval (npm run approve -- protected). The list is read from the base branch, so a branch can't shrink its own. Goldens are not here: a behaviour change re-records them with a Golden-Reason trailer, and the scenarios' expected outcomes (qa.mjs), which are, keep a re-recorded loss from passing as a win. A new file under addOnly (a new regression replay) needs no approval; editing or deleting one does. 2.58.0 (PU-35): the game's own check settings (studio/game.json, which game the gates test, and each game's studio.gates.json, which checks it runs and whether they are required) are protected too.
